snippet.title: Board Of The Future - Virtual Reality Game Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Meta Quest and Steam:
https://www.meta.com/de-de/experiences/board-of-the-future/24345816958450195/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4557330/Board_Of_The_Future/

The BOARD OF THE FUTURE is a mix of a snowboard and a hoverboard. It glides over any terrain, goes really fast, and can jump pretty high. You better wear a helmet!
